summary: Consolidated Edison Company of New York (CECONY) filed an 8-K Item 8.01 disclosing a joint proposal with the NYSDPS for a steam rate plan covering November 2026 to October 2029. The proposal includes base rate increases totaling $13M, $42M, $39M over three years, capital expenditures of $143M/$127M/$126M, 9.5% authorized ROE, and performance-based penalties. It requires NYSPSC approval. This is a regulatory rate case, not a special situation such as M&A or restructuring.
